Module it.polimi.ingsw
Package it.polimi.ingsw.Model.Cards

Class Face

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.Model.Cards.Face
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Face extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a face of a game card, either front or back, containing corners, resources, costs, and objectives.
